Definition: from G2095 and G2540; well-timed, i.e. opportune:--convenient, in time of need.
BiblicalUsage: The word eúkairos carries the sense of convenient, in time of need. In Mark 6:21, the text says "And when a convenient day was come."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, eúkairos means convenient, in time of need, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedEvents: The Death of John the Baptist
